flavor: Jagged pillars of translucent blue ice rise from a floor of powdered snow, trapping frozen, screaming faces within their depths. At the center, a massive, unmoving shape of rime and shadow sits enthroned, its breath a constant, swirling blizzard that muffles all sound.
name: The Frost-Bound Ossuary of Whispers
reason: A powerful ice creature is encased in a localized blizzard, offering cryptic visions or frozen relics to those who brave the cold.
